title: Python for Networking: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Imagine a robot chef who follows recipe cards. Python is the recipe card for your network. Netmiko is the chef that logs into devices.

scenes.heading: The robot chef
scenes.narration: A few libraries do the heavy lifting. Paramiko is the low level S S H library. Netmiko is simpler, and built for network devices. You give it a dictionary with the device type, host, user and password. Use send command to read, and send config set to change.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Netmiko is easier for network gear. It normally runs on your own computer. Use send config set for changes.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva Python networking lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Netmiko makes S S H easy. Send command reads, and send config set changes. Scripts run on your computer. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva Python networking lab.
